skills.title: had + третя форма
skills.rule: had + третя форма для всіх: I had finished, she had seen.

worked.p: I didn't go to the cinema because I ___ that film before. (see)
steps: Фільм бачила раніше за «не пішла» → Past Perfect.
Відповідь: I had seen that film before.

skills.alt:
Це як Present Perfect (have / has + третя форма), тільки «на крок назад у минуле»: have / has → had.

I have eaten → I had eaten. She has gone → she had gone.

items.p: When we arrived, the film ___ started.
h: Фільм почався раніше, ніж ми прийшли (минуле).

items.p: She had ___ her homework before dinner.
By 10 o'clock I ___ my room. (clean)

err.cleaned: By … — до моменту в минулому: had cleaned.

items.p: They ___ the tickets before the trip. (buy)
I didn't go to the cinema because I ___ that film before. (see)
When I got home, my brother ___ all the cake. (eat)
h: Брат з'їв раніше, ніж я прийшла.

err.ate: Він з'їв ще до того, як я прийшла: had eaten.

items.task: Знайди і натисни слово з помилкою
items.p: When I came, they has left.
items.a: When I came, they had left.

items.task: Знайди і натисни слово з помилкою
items.p: She had wrote the letter before lunch.
items.a: She had written the letter before lunch.

items.p: 🎧 The train had left when we arrived.
a: The train had left when we arrived.

skills.title: hadn't, Had you…?
skills.rule: hadn't + третя форма; Had + хто + третя форма? — Yes, I had. / No, she hadn't.

worked.p: We ___ the news before you told us. (not hear)
steps: Ми не чули раніше, ніж ти сказала → Past Perfect.

skills.alt: Усе крутиться довкола had: «не» — hadn't, питання — Had на початок. did тут не потрібен.

items.p: I ___ finished when the bell rang.

err.didn't: Після didn't — перша форма. Тут: hadn't finished.

items.p: ___ you eaten before you came?
Had she seen the film before? — No, she ___.
We ___ the news before you told us. (not hear)

err.didn't hear: Не чули ще ДО того → hadn't heard.

items.p: ___ they left before you arrived?
Had you done your homework? — Yes, I ___.

items.task: Знайди і натисни слово з помилкою
items.p: Had you saw the film before?
items.a: Had you seen the film before?

items.p: 🎧 She hadn't seen the sea before.
a: She hadn't seen the sea before.

Після didn't — перша форма; тут hadn't seen.

skills.title: Past Simple чи Past Perfect
skills.rule: Дія, яка сталася раніше за іншу в минулому, — had + третя форма; пізніша — Past Simple. by the time → Past Perfect.

worked.p: By the time we arrived, the party ___. (finish)
steps: Дві дії: ми прийшли і вечірка закінчилась.
Що раніше? Вечірка закінчилась до нашого приходу.

skills.alt:
Намалюй стрілку часу ⏪: дія лівіше (раніше) — had + третя форма, дія правіше — Past Simple.

⬅️ the film had started … ➡️ we arrived.

items.p: When I arrived at the station, the train ___.
h: Потяг поїхав раніше, ніж я прийшла.

err.leaves: Розповідь про минуле, дія раніше: had left.

items.p: After she ___ her homework, she watched TV.
I ___ my keys, so I couldn't open the door.
Яке речення правильне?
o: When I came home, my brother had eaten all the cake.
When I came home, my brother has eaten all the cake.
items.a: When I came home, my brother had eaten all the cake.

items.task: Впиши дієслово (Past Simple або Past Perfect)
items.p: By the time we arrived, the party ___. (finish)
h: By the time — до того моменту.

err.finished: By the time — вечірка закінчилась ДО того: had finished.

items.task: Впиши дієслово (Past Simple або Past Perfect)
items.p: By 2020 my family ___ to Kyiv. (move)

items.task: Впиши дієслово (Past Simple або Past Perfect)
items.p: Before that trip I ___ snow. (never see)

err.never saw: Досвід до моменту в минулому: had never seen.

items.task: Знайди і натисни слово з помилкою
items.p: When we got to the station, the train has left.
items.a: When we got to the station, the train had left.

items.p: 🎧 By the time I woke up, Mum had made breakfast.
a: By the time I woke up, Mum had made breakfast.

err.By the time I woke up, Mum made breakfas: By the time — сніданок був готовий ДО того: had made.
